credentials.description: Credential slots. May be empty — an anonymous connector is legal.

ontology.description: Declared label emissions. kg additionally checks each label against the shipped ontology (existence, role agreement, tier emittability, primary/marker eligibility) — membership checks this schema deliberately does not duplicate.

publicOrigins.description: The declared egress surface. Must be non-empty.

redirects.description: The only legal value in v1. kg-core package/manifest.rs RedirectPolicy has exactly one variant.

requests.description: The declared request authorities. Must be non-empty.

headerName.description: Required for api-key, forbidden otherwise. Must be a lowercase HTTP token and must not be one of the hop-by-hop or otherwise reserved names kg refuses (authorization, cookie, set-cookie, host, connection, keep-alive, proxy-authenticate, proxy-authorization, te, trailer, transfer-encoding, upgrade, content-length) — that deny-list is enforced by kg, not by this pattern.

sendTo.description: Origin ids this credential may be sent to. Must be non-empty, duplicate-free, and every entry must name a declared origin (the cross-reference is kg's check).

docPath.description: A direct child of docs/ with a .md extension.

fixturePath.description: A direct child of fixtures/ with a .json extension.

family.description: The connector family wire vocabulary MINUS `sql`: kg-core package/manifest.rs refuses sql packages outright ('SQL packages are outside the declarative REST/JSON v1 format'), so `sql` is not a legal manifest value even though the Family wire vocabulary carries it. `crm`, `identity` and `chat` joined the vocabulary between kg main 0e1ae7c7 and fbff2e4f (2026-09-04 re-verification). Arity is a cross-field rule enforced by kg, not by this schema: docs.<leaf>, meetings.<leaf> and chat.<leaf> take two systemKey segments; vcs, work-trackers and design take exactly one; crm and identity carry no arity rule.

systemKey.description: One or two dot-separated segments, each starting with a lowercase letter and containing only lowercase letters, digits and hyphens (hyphens admitted since kg main d10e34e2, 2026-09-02, for keys such as azdo-repos). kg-core registry/doc.rs SystemKey::parse. Family-specific arity (docs.<leaf> and meetings.<leaf> require two segments; vcs, work-trackers and design require exactly one) is a cross-field rule enforced by kg, not by this schema.

version.description: Exact major.minor.patch, no leading zeroes, no pre-release or build metadata. kg-core registry/doc.rs Version::parse, which additionally bounds each segment to a u16 — a range this pattern cannot express.

label.description: Shape only. Whether the label EXISTS in kg's ontology, carries the declared role, and is emittable at this tier is checked by kg (KGCP-ONTOLOGY-*).

origin.description: Canonical origin: https only, lowercase ASCII host (or a bracketed IPv6 literal), an EXPLICIT non-zero port with no leading zeroes, and nothing else — no trailing slash, userinfo, path, query or fragment. kg-core package/manifest.rs canonical_origin.

registryId.description: Canonical connector id: ASCII, 1-32 bytes, first byte a lowercase letter, no trailing hyphen, no doubled hyphen. kg-core registry/identity.rs shape_ok.

credential.description: Optional. When present must name a declared credential slot.

method.description: v1 connectors are read-only; GET is the only legal method.

pathTemplate.description: Absolute path beginning with a single slash. No backslash, query or fragment, no protocol-relative '//' prefix, and no '.' or '..' segments. Percent-escapes that decode to '.', '/', '\' or a control character are additionally refused by kg. kg-core package/manifest.rs valid_path_template.

responseUrls.description: Whether URLs found INSIDE a response body may be followed. The two modes constrain `origins` in opposite directions.

path.description: A direct child of mappings/ with a .json extension. Nested directories are not v1 package vocabulary.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the mapping's exact canonical bytes. Digest EQUALITY against the real file is kg's check.

description: Hand-authored JSON Schema for the kg connector package manifest. This document is DOCUMENTATION, not the authority: `kg connector validate` is the only oracle. CI proves the two agree in both directions (see .github/workflows/ci.yml) — every valid example passes both, and every counter-example in counter-examples/ fails both. Rules kg enforces that a JSON Schema cannot express (cross-reference integrity, ontology label membership, digest equality with real bytes, canonical JSON encoding) are listed in docs/authoring.md and are deliberately absent here.

fixtureFiles.description: Every fixtures/*.json member, strictly sorted. A request binds to the fixture whose file STEM equals the request id.

manifestSchemaVersion.description: Exact schema version. kg-core package/manifest.rs MANIFEST_SCHEMA_VERSION; any other value is KGCP-MANIFEST-VERSION.

semanticFiles.description: Every mappings/*.json member, strictly sorted by path and duplicate-free, each with the lowercase SHA-256 of its exact canonical bytes. Must equal the archive's real mappings/ inventory.
